Remda was the life-mate of Varok Saurfang and the mother of Dranosh. She died shortly before the Horde's first invasion of Azeroth. Before her death, Varok promised her that their son would remain safe and untainted on Draenor, hidden away by the elders of Garadar, rather than accompanying Varok to Azeroth. Remda was cremated on a pyre at the Ancestral Grounds in Nagrand, in the final resting places of the Saurfang family. After Dranosh's death during the war against the Lich King, Varok laid his son to rest in the same location. Renew is a Holy priest class talent. It is automatically learned for Discipline and Holy priests. Renew is a Heal over Time (HoT) spell that heals the target for a reasonable amount over 15 seconds. Renewal of the Sun is a tauren celebration practiced once a year by most tauren tribes. This ritual, performed at the height of summer, celebrates the continued rising and setting of the sun. Tauren view this ceremony as a celebration of the possibilities of a new day, and use it to motivate them to change over the following year. At the Renewal of the Sun, all tauren dress in shades of red and orange and wear gold or copper jewelry. Corn, carrots and other sun-hued vegetables make up most of the feast.

Repair bots are engineer-made mechanical creatures that can buy unwanted goods, sell reagents and (what is most important) repair gear. They are typically consumed upon use. (Jeeves is currently the sole repair bot that is not consumed on use.) As they can be summoned at need (albeit with a cooldown period and often consuming a copy of the bot), they can save great amounts of time on raids and in instances. The repair bot was first invented by Gelbin Mekkatorque.

Ren Whitepaw is a pandaren historian found in the Jade Forest along with his daughter Lina Whitepaw. He was in the Den of Sorrow researching myths surrounding the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, finding Tortured Spirits corrupted by the influence of Y'Shaarj. He later aided Prince Anduin Wrynn against pursuing hozen, being injured in the process. He is later healed by the den's healing waters in Sacred Waters. He accompanies Anduin after he runs away from the SI:7 agents sent to take him home. He and his daughter are not seen afterward.

Ren Yun the Blind was an enigmatic pandaren brewfather. Blind since birth, Ren Yun's other senses were heightened, and as a result he suffered for years with what he considered to be the harsh or bitter taste of the normal pandaren brews of his time. After years of wandering and experimentation, he was able to develop four perfect brews that appealed to each of his other senses. However, the combination of the separate elements into a perfect unifying "one brew" that would appeal to all four senses at the same time eluded him. For a lifetime more he wandered on, until, at the end of his long life, he found to secret to binding all of his sensory beers into one master recipe, the ":Four Sense

This page is a list of Draenor Perks that were removed while was in development. Most of them were removed in August 2014 during the beta, when the Draenor Perks system as a whole was changed. Players originally gained a perk every level from 91 to 99; after the change, they gained perks every other level from 92 to 98 instead. Many perks were removed or baked into their respective spells as a result.

Replenish the Reservoir is one of the two Renown (Shadowlands) weekly quests from the player's covenant. The objective is to gather anima while on the quest -- any anima items already in players' bags will not count. World quests and treasure chests will award some anima. However, a large source of anima are the two weekly dungeon quests and one weekly PvP quest in Oribos.

Renown is a pseudo-currency used to track the player's standing with their chosen Covenant in the Shadowlands. It's effectively a reputation, in single steps from 1 to 80. As players gain more renown, additional features and quests are unlocked. By virtue of the sources, there's an effective cap of three Renown per week until the Covenant Campaign has concluded. After that, players will be able to gain two Renown a week going forward. For alts, or for players who have fallen behind and/or switched covenants, additional sources will provide Renown to help catch them up to the cap. Renathal's Notes are letters located throughout Sinfall in Revendreth, written by Prince Renathal. All notes disappear after their respective Medallions are returned, except those of Dominion and Dread.
Remorseful Spirits are Zandalari troll ghosts located in the Barrow of Bwonsamdi in Dazar'alor.
Repentance Bridge runs between the Decimated Crossroad and Darkhaven in Revendreth.

Remnants of Hope was offered by Bolvar Fordragon first starting in week two of World of Warcraft: Shadowlands, starting December 1. The next quest, Information for a Price, will be offered in week three, or 20 hours after this quest was turned in.
Remote-Detonation Deathbombs are bombs placed in Vol'dun and Zuldazar.
Renard's Den is located in Ardenweald to the east of the Heart of the Forest. It is the home of Lord Renard. A Faintly Glowing Seed can be found here.

The Renounced Bastille is a House of Eyes camp in the northwestern end of Glutharn's Decay in eastern Maldraxxus. This is where Baroness Vashj and her forces are first encountered during the Maldraxxus storyline as they are pursuing vengeance against the House of Rituals.
Repairing Mushrooms are located in the Stalks in Ardenweald. They are the result of using the Fungal Beacon on Damaged Mushrooms.
